summary: This Phase 3 study is testing a drug called berobenatide in adult women with stress urinary incontinence, which means urine leakage when coughing or sneezing, and who are overweight or have obesity. The trial is currently recruiting 900 participants. Sponsored by Pfizer, the study compares the active drug against an inactive placebo. Participants will be in the study for about 63 weeks.
